name: Luxury Goods and Real-Asset Hiding by Designated Persons
description: Designated persons may convert financial assets into yachts, aircraft, art, jewellery, property or collectibles held through intermediaries to avoid freezing. Detection is relevant to banks, art and luxury dealers, brokers, registries and corporate service providers.

sources.text: FinCEN, FinCEN Advises Increased Vigilance for Potential Russian Sanctions Evasion Attempts (FIN-2022-Alert001, March 2022)
FATF, Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing in the Art and Antiquities Market (2023)
OFSI, UK Financial Sanctions General Guidance

indicators.name: Purchase of high-value assets by newly formed entities with opaque owners
indicators.canon: High-value asset held through opaque vehicle
indicators.desc: Property, art, vessels or other valuables are acquired or held via a company, trust or storage arrangement with concealed beneficial owners.
indicators.ctx: Yacht, aircraft, art or property is bought through a company with unclear beneficial owners. Real estate held by shell companies with nominee directors.
indicators.fp: Privacy-driven structures are common among wealthy buyers. Privacy legislation applies.

indicators.name: Asset transfers shortly before or after designation
indicators.canon: Asset transfers shortly before or after designation
indicators.desc: Titles move to relatives, trusts or associates around designation dates.
indicators.ctx: Titles move to relatives, trusts or associates around designation dates.

indicators.name: Maintenance, crew or insurance costs paid by third parties
indicators.canon: Payments from or for third parties unrelated to the underlying trade
indicators.desc: Payments are made by parties with no apparent link to the underlying transaction, goods or services.
indicators.ctx: Running costs of an asset are paid by persons unconnected to the registered owner.
indicators.fp: Managers pay on behalf of owners.

indicators.name: Art or collectibles purchased with no evidence of buyer interest and stored in free ports
indicators.canon: Art or collectibles held in free ports without display or trade
indicators.desc: Artworks are acquired and stored long term in free ports with no movement, display or documented purpose.
indicators.ctx: Works are acquired and stored without display or documented purpose.

indicators.name: Cash or quick settlement of purchases with source of funds unclear
indicators.canon: High-value purchases paid in cash, crypto or non-standard funds
indicators.desc: High-value assets are bought with cash, crypto, third-party or otherwise non-standard funding.
indicators.ctx: Large purchase settled via irregular channels.

indicators.name: Vessel or aircraft registered under flags of convenience with managers in secrecy locations
indicators.canon: Vessel or aircraft registered under flags of convenience with managers in secrecy locations
indicators.desc: Registration choices obscure the true owner.
indicators.ctx: Registration choices obscure the true owner.

indicators.name: Advisers or agents who act for multiple designated-linked clients
indicators.canon: Adviser or agent acting for multiple linked clients
indicators.desc: A single provider, broker, lawyer or agent sets up entities or handles transactions for many related clients with similar structures.
indicators.ctx: Single broker or lawyer appears across several linked purchases.
